LanguageData.WSR_GameStartDialog:
Less grinding. Less downtime. More action!

Wave Survival skips most of the slow early-game gathering of vanilla RimWorld. Build your base quickly, then defend it from wave after wave of raiders until your colony inevitably collapses spectacularly.

Build an orbital trade beacon to receive the daily supply drops. The first wave arrives in five days.
LanguageData.WSR_WaveTimerSpecial: This is a special wave: a siege, sappers, breachers, mechanoids, or maddened animals.
LanguageData.WSR_NeedBeaconExplanation:
Wave Survival drops supplies by pod at your orbital trade beacon once a day. Until you build one, the daily drop waits.
Build one as soon as you can.
LanguageData.WSR_SupplyDropArrived: A supply drop has landed at the trade beacon.
LanguageData.WSR_WaveTimerBoss: This is a boss wave: one and a half times the usual strength.
LanguageData.WSR_WavePostponed: Wave {0} could not start: nobody hostile is able to attack. Trying again in {1}.
LanguageData.WSR_WavePostponedNoHome: Wave {0} is waiting for you to have a home map. Trying again in {1}.
LanguageData.WSR_NeedBeaconFallback: After {0} days without a beacon, a smaller drop with no weapon lands near the colony instead.
LanguageData.WSR_SupplyDropFallback: With no trade beacon, a smaller supply drop has landed near the colony.
LanguageData.WSR_WaveSummaryLeft: {0} of them were still standing when the next wave came.
LanguageData.WSR_SettingsShowHudTip: A small box at the top of the screen with the next wave, what it will be, and how the last one went.
